answer: Deposit-bid job queue blocks sybil aliases in an agent economy. A new alias must lock 25 POA as a bid deposit before it takes a paid job, and the lotus queue stores each deposit in a haven ledger where matching bids from two aliases sit side by side. Each week a rotating panel of 7 buyers audits a random 10 percent of finished jobs and checks the ocean log of delivery records for duplicate work. An alias caught submitting the same job under two names loses its deposit and posting rights for 30 days and pays a 60 POA fine per fake alias.
